title: feat(study): player cards, list view and Hide names
body:
**Size:** L  
**Spec:** `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-15-play-redesign-2-0-design.md`: §5, §6 (study), §7 (reveal), §14 item 5  
**Depends on:** #114 (`PlayerCard`)

Study becomes player cards, with a compact list view and Hide names for self-testing. Both were confirmed on 2026-10-15.

### Work

- [ ] Header:
  - back, the Hide names toggle and the grid/list toggle
  - the team banner, the season, "SQUAD"
  - a count ("26 players", or "9 of 26" when filtered)
- [ ] All / GK / DF / MF / FW filters with counts, sorted by shirt number
- [ ] Grid by default: two columns of `PlayerCard`s, 218 pt tall
- [ ] List: 64 pt rows with a 46 pt avatar. The grid/list choice persists as `studyView` in `stores/progress.ts`
- [ ] Hide names:
  - each name becomes a dashed "Tap to reveal" pill, and a tap reveals it (a light haptic)
  - toggling it clears the reveals
  - not persisted
- [ ] "Photo credits · N" at the end of the list. Each row names its photo by shirt number only, so Hide names is not spoiled
- [ ] Virtualised lists (`FlatList`, two columns in the grid). Photos load as cards mount (`expo-image`, `recyclingKey` = player id), never a whole squad at once
- [ ] The missed view goes:
  - the `players` and `level` params, the "Missed Players" title, the retry button
  - `StudyRow`
  - `parsePlayerIds` and `parseLevel` if nothing else uses them
- [ ] `study.opened` stays as it is: Hide names and the view toggle are not tracked
- [ ] `design/SCREENS.md`: the Study description
- [ ] Regenerate `design/screens`

### Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Grid and list both work in both themes, for club and nation squads
- [ ] Hide names hides every name, including in the credits
- [ ] Scrolling a 26-player squad loads photos as cards mount, not all up front
- [ ] `npm run check` passes


### From #113 (About text)

- The About "What is stored on your device" list counts what `stores/progress.ts` persists. #113 makes it seven things by adding whether vibration is on. Persisting `studyView` makes it **eight**: add the grid/list choice to that paragraph in this PR (spec §10 item 4).
- About's "Player photos" paragraph will need Study's clause from spec §10 item 1: "…and a squad's photos on the Study screen as you scroll". Add it here, when Study starts loading photos.
why: A closed issue (merged in #131): the skill asks before doing anything.
